breeding_nucleus_floor.description: Never drain a farm below this many animals in a balancing move, so every farm keeps a breeding nucleus.

enabled.description: Master switch for QoS Chickens. Ships OFF: install it, look around, then turn it on when you want daily balancing to start.

fill_first_farm_ids.description: Fill-first mode only: comma-separated entity ids of farms, in the order they should be filled (each to capacity or its slaughter limit). Empty = fill-first does nothing.

log_moves.description: Write one log line per scheduled move (farm, amount, predicted spread).

max_animals_moved_per_day.description: Cap on animals moved per in-game day across all species — one vanilla UI button-press worth. Keeps balancing gradual.

mode.description: Balancing policy: 'equalise' converges same-species farms to within +/-1 of each other; 'fill_first' fills the farms listed in fill_first_farm_ids in order; 'off' does nothing.
